notes: CR 508.1a: a creature tapped for mana in the main phase is not an untapped creature, so it cannot be declared as an attacker (2026-11-05 audit: mana creatures tapped for mana and then attacked). Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer tapping a source (CR 605.3a), so the pack casts with "tap": true. Llanowar Visionary, the only source, pays Skyway Sniper's {G} and taps; the bear attacks alone for 2.
